The layers of taxation needs to be examined as a whole. What @SenWarren tends to be dishonest or simply obtuse about (likely a mix of both per her usual theatrics) is that to take her premise a step further, price fixing would be required to make her system of taxation not be directly borne by consumers. For an avid socialist - this lack of economic growth works great. She already has her bucks and is a party leader. Shrinking the pie for others is what empowers her. For the country though? Her plan works terribly and hurts the economy. And it's always the same playbook for her, which is on full display with her dishonest criticism of the CLARITY act. At this point, the question isn't her dishonesty or even the motivations behind it. The question is: given her repeated and long standing history of this behavior, why does anyone listen to her at all?
